easyPrerequisites: You control a land that can tap to produce at least {G} or have a basic Forest in your library.
description:
Cast Encroaching Dragonstorm by paying {3}[G}.
When Encroaching Dragonstorm enters, it first ability triggers, causing you to search your library for two basic land cards and put them onto the battlefield tapped
When the lands enter the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Nesting Dragon trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land that can produce {G}.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve a Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax and Encroaching Dragonstorm's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Encroaching Dragonstorm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters the battlefield, Ganax triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat
